content: 1 A song of degrees. Ovt of the deepe places haue I called vnto thee, O Lord. 2 Lorde, heare my voyce: let thine eares attend to the voyce of my prayers. 3 If thou, O Lord, straightly markest iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand? 4 But mercie is with thee, that thou mayest be feared. 5 I haue waited on the Lord: my soule hath waited, and I haue trusted in his worde. 6 My soule waiteth on the Lorde more then the morning watch watcheth for the morning. 7 Let Israel waite on the Lorde: for with the Lorde is mercie, and with him is great redemption. 8 And he shall redeeme Israel from all his iniquities.
